method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; three regulative rules (ss 66(10)(c), 84(3)(b) notify the Federal Court within the period of 3 months starting on the notification day; s 30(1)(a)(i) file the claimant application before the end of 3 months after the notification day; s 190E(2)(b) apply to the NNTT for reconsideration within 42 days) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. The first encoding of the Act in Commons. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Native Title Act 1993 (No. 110, 1993), Compilation No. 50, compilation date 12 June 2024, includes amendments to Act No. 41, 2024 (register id C2024C00224), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A04665.txt (retrieved 13 October 2026). Not deposited: the Native Title (Federal Court) Regulations, the Federal Court Rules, the Acts Interpretation Act 1901, and State and Territory laws under ss 23E, 23I, 43, 43A.

scope: Part 3 Division 1: s 61(1) (claim group and registered native title body corporate rows for native title determination and compensation applications), (2); s 61A; s 66B(1), (2), (2A); s 66(10)(c) with s 84(2), (3), (5). Part 2 Division 3 Subdivision P: ss 29(2)(b)(i), (4), 30(1)(a), (2), 31(1C), (1D), 32(2)-(7), 35(1)-(3), 36(2), 37, 38(1), (2), 41(1), (2), with 31(1)(b) and 33(1) in answers. Part 2 Division 4: ss 47, 47A, 47B. Part 2 Division 5: ss 50(2), 51, 51A, 53(1). Part 7: ss 190A(2), (2A), (6), (6A), (6B), 190B(2)-(9), 190C(2)-(5), 190E(1)-(4), 190F(1), (3). s 251B. Out: s 62 and s 61(3)-(5) (folded into one input), s 47C, the rest of the future act regime and ILUAs, ss 23A-23JA, the arbitral body's and Ministers' procedure and criteria, ss 52, 52A, ss 62A, 64, 66A, 66B(3)-(4), Federal Court and NNTT procedure, registers, representative bodies, prescribed bodies corporate. Reasons in NOTES.md.
focus: the provisions a claimant meets: who may apply and what may be claimed, registration of the claim and review, becoming a party, the right to negotiate, and compensation
